name: Band Pass-Through
instructions: Stand holding a resistance band wide in front of your thighs with your arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the band overhead and behind your head as far as comfortable.
Reverse the motion back to your thighs.
Use a wider grip if it feels tight, and keep your ribs down.
image_prompt_scene: Standing tall with both arms straight up overhead, holding a short resistance band stretched taut and horizontal between both fists, hands about twice shoulder-width apart, the band begins and ends at the fists and nothing hangs below the hands, the band is not near the floor or the feet.
